title: VOL Tool � Contact Center (ADDCOL + No ACNP) � Promise Updates to VOL Arrival � Not Eligible
description:
Customer called the Contact Center and voluntarily changed their flight. Identifier: ADDCOL present in PNR history AND no ACNP (Air Canada No Pay) marker. The absence of ACNP confirms this was a customer-initiated change (VOL), not an airline-initiated accommodation (INVOL). Promise updates to VOL arrival.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Marc-Antoine Gagnon); 1 leg AC YUL?YYZ; Original (14-day) arrival: 08:00; CC change at D-7: ADDCOL in history, no ACNP, new arrival 11:00; Flight operates on time; Actual arrival: 11:00; No disruption code; 72 hrs elapsed; No duplicate; Not employee; Not infant
